name: table-column-remove
useCase: Remove a selected table column in an editor.
misuse: Do not use the minus alone to indicate that a column has already been deleted.

16.reason: A narrower two-column grid reserves 1px before a separate minus while keeping equal columns and three clear rows.

24.reason: The independently spaced two-column grid leaves at least 1.5px before the minus and retains equal columns with three rows.
